description: This file contains tests for Vitest configuration functions and helpers, including resolution of worker counts based on system load and environment variables, parsing of process stats, and default configuration values. It includes multiple test cases validating behavior of functions like resolveLocalVitestMaxWorkers, resolveLocalVitestScheduling, and parseVitestProcessStats, as well as verifying default config settings.

methods.name: resolveDefaultVitestPool
methods.description: Returns the default pool type for Vitest, which is 'threads'.

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestMaxWorkers
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of local workers based on environment variables, system specs, and load stats.

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestScheduling
methods.description: Determines scheduling parameters like max workers and whether file parallelism is enabled based on system load and other active Vitest instances.

methods.name: parseVitestProcessStats
methods.description: Parses process information to count the number of other Vitest root and worker processes and sums their CPU usage, excluding the current process.
